title: Grilled Italian Sausage and Chicken
description: A summer-inspired dish featuring grilled Italian sausage and chicken, served with a side of sweet focaccia bread.

ingredients.name: Wrapped Italian Dressing
ingredients.notes: you can make your own dressing using the ingredients

instructions: Season the chicken and sausage with salt, pepper, and your favorite herbs.
Grill the chicken and sausage for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Slice the focaccia into 1-inch thick slices and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the focaccia with Italian dressing and top with fresh basil leaves.
Bake the focaccia in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
To assemble the dish, place a few slices of grilled chicken and sausage onto a plate, and serve with a side of sweet focaccia bread.
Optional: use a lotus leaf to steam the chicken and sausage for a few minutes before serving.
